meta.title: Novel Workbench
meta.description: Novel Workbench: write a long novel in one place — desk, manuscript, decisions, memory, style studio, canon and sources. Four context segments budgeted before you write; checks that jump to the exact sentence; every chapter committed in a recoverable transaction.

name: Novel Workbench
description: A workbench for long-form and fan fiction: plot decisions, world contract, long-term memory and voice style are assembled into four budgeted context segments before each chapter. One chain per chapter (plan → start → write → check → commit, resumable), per-entry canon review, drafts protected when switching books, and off by default so it never clutters your tool list.
